acceptance: Pinned Node/Worker entry points and local PostgreSQL query/rollback run reproducibly; no cloud account required.
Validated request/response schemas and generated OpenAPI agree; fixtures include two projects with distinct members.
Clean install and upgrade enforce workspace/project ancestry, versions, uniqueness and receipt/outbox relationships.
Request IDs, safe errors, deadlines, rate/body limits and structured timing work without exposing secrets.
Chosen OAuth login creates one identity/session; unsupported callbacks fail closed and private data needs a valid session.
Logout revokes server session; expired tabs retain safe drafts but cannot keep reading or writing protected data.
Name/avatar updates display correctly; historical actors remain attributable after grant removal without leaking private account fields.
Account creates a workspace and exactly one owner atomically; a lost response replay does not create a second workspace.
Owner sets workspace name/timezone; date-only deadlines retain their selected day and shared overdue semantics.
Show only owned containers and explicitly granted projects; being owner elsewhere grants no extra rights here.
Only current owner transfers to an eligible account atomically; no interval has zero/multiple owners and no stale grant escalates.
Owner creates named projects inside their workspace; each has independent membership and boards.
Owned projects and invited projects are paginated and scoped; hidden projects leak no name, count or existence.
Owner/manager updates project name/description using expected version; managers cannot alter workspace ownership.
Owner archives project as read-only and can reopen; data/history remain, trash deadlines continue and new imports/writes stop.
Owner/manager sees authorized project members; picker exposes only eligible identities and never enumerates unrelated projects.
Owner invites manager/member/viewer; project manager invites member/viewer only; invitation names the exact project and inherited boards.
Durable invite delivery uses a configured email adapter; failure is visible and retryable without logging the secret link.
Signed-in verified email must match unexpired, hashed, single-use project token; wrong email grants nothing.
Authorized resend rotates token; revoke invalidates it; races create at most one grant and invitation outcome.
Owner sees all own projects; manager sees own project invitations; expired/accepted/revoked states and next actions are clear.
Owner appoints/removes managers; manager changes member/viewer roles only and cannot promote self or a peer manager.
Owner removes any grant; manager removes member/viewer in own project; next API/file/import/replay access fails after revocation.
Invitee can leave their own grant with confirmation; owner cannot leave ownership and historical authorship remains.
Every endpoint derives active ownership/project grant from session; manager authority is project-scoped and member/viewer cannot administer.
Guessing sibling board/card/comment/file/import IDs returns a consistent private not-found response with no metadata leakage.
Grant/owner lock protocol serializes a write against role removal; no write commits after a preceding revocation wins.
Search, people, assignees, mentions, inbox and historical identity responses expose only the actor's authorized project context.
Board invitation action explicitly grants project access to all its boards; no hidden board-only permission exception exists.
Owner/manager creates a board with default columns atomically inside an authorized project.
List only accessible project boards; owner/manager renames a board without breaking card IDs/links.
Metadata, counts and first column pages share one snapshot; caps/cursors are explicit and all filters count beyond the visible page.
Owner/manager configures unique normalized names, colors and todo/active/done categories with expected board version.
Pointer and click/tap/keyboard ordering persist atomically; missing/duplicate/foreign IDs and stale revisions fail clearly.
Owner/manager cannot remove final column or any column referenced by active/restorable cards; no silent card deletion/move occurs.
Load more retains canonical order without duplicates; empty column and empty filtered column are distinct and stale cursors refresh.
Owner/manager makes board read-only or reopens it; no card is deleted and pending trash deadlines continue.
Member/manager/owner creates title in an active authorized column; required field and retry failures retain draft and create once.
Show title, priority, due date, assignees and accurate comment/image counts without loading full descriptions/history.

feature: Open detail dialog and deep link
acceptance: Card link loads an authorized popup/drawer or direct-page view with focus restoration and recoverable missing/loading states.
Explicit Save validates plain text and expected card version; Cancel/discard never overwrites saved state.
Five priority values and optional date-only deadline save/reset consistently; invalid calendar dates fail and overdue excludes done cards.
Assign zero/multiple active eligible project users or owner; removed identities stay labeled historical and cannot be newly assigned.
Server validates neighbors and versions, changes rank/history atomically and returns canonical position; failure restores server order.
Visible Move chooses column plus first/last/before/after via bounded placement read; equivalent outcome without dragging.
Explain disabled ambiguous drag while filters apply; Move uses full destination order rather than renumbering visible cards only.
Stale field/order version returns 409 without partial side effects; preserve draft and allow deliberate refresh/reapply.

feature: Save pending errors and unsaved drafts
acceptance: Save affects fields only; comment/upload actions are independent; retries keep command identity and closing protects unsaved work.
Undo is a new authorized versioned move; it succeeds once or explains conflict without overwriting intervening work.
Project readers see chronological comments with author displays; stable cursors do not expose other project content.
Member/manager/owner posts plain text independently of card Save; atomic event/outbox/receipt and lost-response retry create one comment.
Accessible picker resolves active project identities; validated UTF-16 spans produce mentions and literal at-name text does not notify.
Author updates with expected version; edit activity persists and v1 edits do not resend mention notifications.
Author or owner/manager tombstones a comment, records action and hides body from normal reads; other members cannot moderate.
Typing, mention selection and post error survive field saves/refetch; no comment posts accidentally through Enter in a picker.
Authorized editor requests bounded upload and sees progress/cancel; private staging cannot attach files across projects.
Accept validated PNG/JPEG/WebP bytes with size/dimension/count caps; reject SVG/HTML/spoofed MIME and finalize only after verification.
Finalized images show filename/size/thumbnail and preview; failed or pending upload is not shown as a saved attachment.
Authenticated proxy checks current project access on every fetch; no public bucket/long-lived URL or project-revocation bypass.
Uploader or owner/manager removes image with confirmation/history; removed images are absent from active card and cleanup is retryable.
Expired uploads/unreferenced objects are cleaned safely; quotas fail visibly without breaking existing saved card fields.
Trashing card preserves finalized files until restore cutoff; restore recovers them and purge never destroys a successfully restored card's images.
Owner sees create, field change, assignment, move, comment and actor/server timestamp chronologically with stable pagination.
Record safe before/after field values and from/to columns; historical name changes and removed people remain understandable.
Owner filters owned workspace activity by project/card/actor/action/date; invited users cannot access sibling-project audit data.
Manager sees project activity/access changes; member/viewer sees card activity only for granted project; workspace security log is owner-only.
Trash/restore/purge/import/image events are traceable; no secret token or raw file appears in audit payloads.
No user edits audit facts; sensitive/deleted bodies are redacted under retention rules while actor/action/time facts persist.
Owner/manager confirms Delete, moves card to trash with server deletedAt/restoreUntil and immediately excludes it from active counts/search.
Owner/manager lists trashed cards with actor/deadline and restore action; member/viewer cannot browse trash.
Owner/manager restores same ID/content/comments/finalized images strictly before server cutoff; no-op repeats do not extend deadline.
Original valid column/nearest surviving position is default; absent/read-only destination requires explicit authorized active target or reopening board.
At or after deletedAt plus exactly 24 hours restore returns stable expired response even if cleanup has not run.
Conditional state/version and job fencing allow one winner; cleanup cannot purge restored data or files.
After cutoff remove recoverable content/files via retryable cleanup; retain minimal audit/duplicate tombstones with no deleted body.
Trashed/expired cards reject edits/moves/comments/new uploads; UI explains disappearance while retaining safe unsent drafts.
Versioned seven-column Cards template plus Instructions downloads without example rows in the import sheet.
Owner/manager chooses one project/board and default column; upload cannot create projects/users/grants or override destination.
Accept supported XLSX only, enforce compressed/expanded/cell/row limits and reject formulas/macros/external package links without evaluating them.
Exact seven headers map shared card validators; status/date/email errors name row/field and no invalid value is silently guessed.

feature: Preview new existing and conflict rows
acceptance: Preview counts new/already-imported/conflicting/invalid rows, displays mapping and writes no cards; user corrects errors before confirming.
Bind preview to actor/target/digest/expiry; revalidate grant/columns/assignees and create all new rows in one bounded transaction or none.
Board-scoped text External ID preserves zeros; duplicate upload/race creates once, changed ID payload conflicts and deleted imports never resurrect silently.
Real 1900/1904 Excel dates or strict ISO map to date-only values; semicolon emails resolve active eligible project users only.
Result links created cards and row outcomes; safe report cannot execute spreadsheet formulas or leak another project's data.
Cancel before commit/expiry cleans temporary content; once transaction begins show actual final result rather than promise cancellation.
Import receipt links actor/batch/rows/created cards, while each card behaves like a normal card with a creation activity event.
One event/recipient notification appears after commit; no self-mention or duplicate logical delivery and no stale private preview leak.

feature: Inbox read state and deep link
acceptance: Actor opens accessible project/card and marks read; removed-access notifications are redacted/hidden and never reveal content.
Lease/fenced consumer retries bounded jobs and quarantines failures; restart/duplicate handling does not lose accepted notification intent.
Title search returns authorized active cards only with pagination and safe historical people mapping.
Filters combine predictably, distinguish total/matching counts and exclude trash; no global project discovery through query parameters.
Show actor's assignments across only accessible projects, grouped by project and due state; removed access disappears on next request.

feature: Empty loading failed and forbidden states
acceptance: First project/empty board/no matches/loading/offline/validation/permission errors have accurate actions and preserve relevant drafts.
Keyboard and click/tap complete all essential operations; focus, announcements, labels and color-independent cues are verified in browser.
Board scroll and detail layout work at narrow width/zoom; long titles, many assignees and image/comment lists remain usable.
Pause hidden-tab polling, refresh on focus and reconcile versions; no optimistic duplicate/older response overwrites newer data.
Representative Worker/Node warm/cold benchmarks, project isolation, exact restore boundary and repeated import pass documented gates.
